data.name: Ulrico
data.gender_notes: Ulrico is used as a male name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Latin word 'ulcus' meaning 'wolf' and 'ricus' meaning 'power' or 'ruler'. In Christianity, Saint Ulric is remembered as a bishop and martyr who defended the faith in the Alamanni region of present-day Germany. The name Ulrico carries the meaning “Wolf strength” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Hebrew, Greek. Parents who choose Ulrico usually hope their child will grow to embody wolf strength and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes strength, courage, and leadership in the face of adversity.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Ulrico total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.

in_hebrew.name: אולריקו
in_hebrew.long_meaning: אולריקו הוא שם נוצרי שמקורו בשם הגרמני 'ריכארד', שמשמעותו 'שומר זכר אלוהים'. השם מורכב מ'וולף' שפירושו ז狼 ו-'ריק' שפירושו שליט או מלך. השם אולריקו משמש כמזכרת לאלוהים כמלך ומשומר על עמו.

in_greek.name: Ουλρικό
in_greek.long_meaning: Ουλρικό είναι ένα Χριστιανικό όνομα που προέρχεται από το Γερμανικό όνομα 'Ρίχαρντ', που σημαίνει 'ο φύλακας του Θεού'. Το όνομα αποτελείται από το 'wolf' που σημαίνει λύκος και το 'rich' που σημαίνει άρχοντας ή βασιλιάς. Το Ουλρικό χρησιμεύει ως υπενθύμιση του Θεού ως βασιλιά και φύλακα του λαού Του.

in_latin.name: Ulrico
in_latin.long_meaning: Ulrico est nomen christianum quod originem trahit ex nomine germanico 'Richard', quod significat 'custos Dei'. Nomen constat ex 'wolf' quod significat lupus et 'rich' quod significat dominus vel rex. Ulrico servit ad memoriam Dei tanquam regis et custodis populi sui.

in_english.name: Ulrico
in_english.meaning: Ulrico means ruler of the people or God's guardian
in_english.long_meaning: Ulrico is a Christian name derived from the Germanic name 'Richard', meaning 'ruler of the people' or 'God's guardian'. It originates from the Old High German words 'wolf' (wolf) and 'rich' (ruler or king). Historically, the name signifies a strong leader or protector chosen by God. In Christian tradition, Ulrico symbolizes divine protection and guidance. The name carries connotations of strength, leadership, and spiritual guardianship.

data.cultural_impact: Saint Ulric is a venerated figure in the Austrian Alps, where he is believed to protect against wild animals and natural disasters. In the region of South Tyrol, his feast day is celebrated on August 23rd with traditional festivities and alpine games.
data.spiritual_significance: In Christian iconography, Saint Ulric is often depicted as a herdsman or a bishop with a wolf or a bear at his feet, symbolizing his protection and peaceful coexistence with nature and its wild creatures. He is a reminder of God's power and protection, even in the face of danger or adversity. Additionally, his martyrdom and dedication to the faith inspire Christians to be brave and steadfast in their beliefs, even in the face of persecution or opposition.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Ulrico, derived from the name Ulrich, means "strong, ruler, wolf-power." It represents the spiritual strength and leadership qualities of a devoted Christian, embodying both inner courage and wise guidance.
